description: Change an existing campaign: its name, description, where links send people, status (active, or inactive to pause it), the commission, whether it is listed in the Discovery marketplace, whether new affiliates are approved automatically, or the recurring commission terms. Send only what changes; everything else stays as it is. Confirm the exact change with the user before calling, because affiliates see the new terms at once. Commission tiers, coupon codes, files and prices are changed on the dashboard. Returns the campaign and `changed`, the fields that actually changed. Requires Pro plan or higher; live keys only.

autoApproveAffiliates.description: Approve affiliates who join through the join link without review

commissionType.description: Percentage of the sale, or a fixed amount per sale

commissionValue.description: The percent (e.g. 25) or the fixed amount in the campaign currency

enableRecurringCommissions.description: Also pay commission on subscription renewals

isPublic.description: List the campaign in the Discovery marketplace

name.description: New campaign name, at least 2 characters

recurringCommissionCount.description: Payments that pay commission, including the first

recurringCommissionDurationMonths.description: Months of renewals that pay commission

recurringCommissionMode.description: Limit renewals by months since the first sale, or by number of payments

recurringCommissionType.description: Renewals pay the same rate as the first sale, or a custom rate

recurringCommissionValue.description: The renewal rate when recurringCommissionType is custom

status.description: active runs the campaign; inactive pauses it
